added_failures_note: baseline_suite at b2de715e names three failures (test_a_missing_pointer_is_recorded_with_what_stood_on_disk, test_an_executable_that_cannot_be_run_still_names_the_command_and_path, test_a_relaunch_keeps_the_earlier_attempts_exit_record) and after_suite at 4e30315c76 names none, so the difference adds no failure; the targeted population failure the manifest records under retry_failures (test_a_delivered_run_released_after_its_halt_is_not_recreated) is outside the suite pair and passes in isolation at both arms.

findings.text: the commit carries pure reflow edits to two pre-existing conditionals (:3420 and :3514, plus the pending_step_since assignments beside them) that the change never touches, so the diff mixes formatting churn with the intent and is harder to read against its base.

_publish_stored_phase is handed the in-memory failure_record carrying the spec's attempt number (1 on a relaunch) while _write_attempt_artifact stores the free number (2) in the receipt, so the pointer's stored record and attempt-2-exit.json disagree about which attempt failed.

_admitting_pass_identity is the only producer of the launch-failure record's admitting_pass, and no test exercises it — the gate supplies that dict as a literal to write_handover — so a regression dropping pid, at or code from the stamp would leave the gate green while the record lost the pass identity it exists to carry.
